ambient_events: The four throttles inch forward under the pilot's hand, needles climbing in sympathy.
Green nav glass washes over the cramped deck, the world outside sliding past the wraparound glass.
A trim wheel spins itself a half-turn and stops, and the airframe settles into the new attitude.
description: The flight deck of the Leviathan — a cramped glass nose bolted to the front of a cargo cathedral. Wraparound windows wrap the pilot's seat in the moving world; four throttle levers stand between the seats, and the panel is a wall of turquoise-lit gauges older than most cities. Whoever holds this seat holds the whole ship. The main cabin lies AFT, to the SOUTH.
name: Flight Deck
